newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on position squaring.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on position squaring.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Friday on squaring of short-sell positions before a four-day break for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival, dealers said. The market will reopen on Monday.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 3.02 points, or 0.20 percent, up at 1,522.60 amid 154 losers and 74 gainers. Volume fell to 45 million from Tuesday's 54 million.
Prices of speculative stocks moved slightly up as jobbers tried to square their short-sell positions, a dealer at Ali Husain Rajabali said. No major buying was witnessed during the session.
"This short-covering attitude is much better for the overall market scenario," the dealer said.
Hub Power rose 0.25 to 35.80 rupees, Pakistan Telecom 0.10 to 26.80. ICI Pakistan fell 0.15 to 22.70. Pakistan State Oil rose 2.00 to 275.
